==About==

A {{i|Trunk-Nosed Lake Perch}} can be dried on a {{i|Drying Frame}} for 72 hours to make a {{i|Dried Trunk-Nosed Lake Perch}}. Due to the current nature of the most recent Fish rework there is no reason to ever make a Dried Trunk-Nosed Lake Perch.
